# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and performance sprint** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the engine to Skia m151 with a broad managed-layer performance sprint and .NET 11 WASM support. Multiple allocation-free and zero-copy optimizations land across SKColor, SKPMColor, HarfBuzzSharp, and SKShaper. Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries bring .NET 11 WASM support with the new exnref exception-handling model. No breaking changes in this release.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine advances to m151, including multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges and a CPU raster regression fix (restored SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT). — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor and SKPMColor conversions ported to managed integer math** — SKColor ↔ SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed code without P/Invoke, eliminating round-trip overhead on hot color paths. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — The hex-color parser is rewritten for speed and gains new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, reducing allocations in string-heavy color parsing workflows. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **SKShaper glyph results read via zero-copy spans** — Glyph output arrays are now consumed through zero-copy spans instead of marshalled copies, reducing allocation and native-boundary traffic in shaping-heavy workloads. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocates per call** — The per-call char[4] allocation in SKFourByteTag.Parse is eliminated, benefiting consumers that parse many font tags (feature lists, codec options) in a loop. ([#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI)** — When a region-cropped decode failed, the native image was not released. The fix closes the leak for all failure paths in the SKData + SKRectI overload. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM** — Pre-built native libraries for Emscripten 5.0.6 (with the new exnref exception-handling model required by .NET 11) are shipped, enabling SkiaSharp on .NET 11 preview WASM targets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships two allocation-free performance improvements: AddUtf8(string) uses a pooled UTF-8 encoder to avoid per-call heap allocation, and Tag.Parse no longer allocates a char[4] on each call. WASM builds gain Emscripten 5.0.6 support.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

RC 1 shipped Emscripten 5.0.6 / .NET 11 WASM support (with exnref exception handling), ported SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor operations to managed integer math, fixed a CPU raster regression from a shader-context removal, and patched a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Preview 2 delivered the performance sprint: allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp Tag.Parse and AddUtf8, zero-copy SKShaper glyph spans, SKColor hex-parse optimization with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, elimination of SKFourByteTag per-call allocation, and further m151 upstream stability fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)
